title: DocumentSchema
description: Schema for source medical documents (e.g. NICE Guidelines) in the data governance pipeline.

document_id.description: Unique identifier for the document, e.g. doc_nice_acs_chest_pain

source_id.description: Identifier of the publisher or repository, e.g. nice_guidelines

title.description: Full clinical title of the guideline document

filename.description: Relative filename within the repository, e.g. nice_acs_chest_pain.md

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the complete raw document content for auditability

metadata.description: Additional domain-specific tags, specialties, or version details
